summary: A strong, unusually complete Phase 1 artifact with an exemplary honesty posture. The canonical desktop capture is a faithful likeness of the Nord Stage 4 73: one continuous red chassis at 0.9400 of viewport width, aspect 3.0951, a 0.54/0.46 deck/keybed split, the six sections at their documented widths (13/21/15/9/21/21%), a 73-key E1–E7 keybed (43 white / 30 black), nine organ drawbars with LED ladders, the wheel/master-level performance cluster, and exactly two primary OLEDs located only in Program and Synth. Materials read correctly (red metal, dark inset plates, black indexed knobs, fader/drawbar caps, red/green LED ladders, blue-green OLEDs, white legends) though micro-detail (Nord logotype glyphs, screw heads, brushed texture, printed scale numerals) is simplified — all disclosed in the audit. The piano is one dependable generated voice fed through a single unified note lifecycle: pointer/multi-touch, mapped computer keys with repeat suppression, and Web MIDI note/velocity/CC64 all route through one controller with per-source note ownership, correct velocity-to-level mapping, sustain latch, deterministic oldest-first 24-voice stealing, a soft-limiter master path with a reduced-path fallback, and full blur/MIDI-disconnect/unmount all-notes-off cleanup. The honesty boundary is airtight: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json truthfully declares live oscillator synthesis with no sample claims, the presentation store is completely isolated from audio, and a dedicated test asserts that operating panel controls creates no AudioContext and does not disturb playing voices. Engineering is high quality — 129 deterministic test cases with an injectable AudioContext fake that models real graph topology (reachesDestination, live-node kinds), zero console messages in both captures, and no reference photograph embedded. The main gaps are cosmetic/legibility only: at 390x844 the whole instrument is width-scaled so legends become sub-pixel and illegible (nothing clips), and typography/decorative detail is approximated rather than exact.

stage1-desktop.png shows red metal chassis, dark blue-gray inset plates, black indexed knobs, fader/drawbar caps, red & green LED ladders, blue-green OLEDs, white legends, and 'nord stage 4 / HAMMER ACTION 73' branding.

stage1-visual-audit.md:67,71 discloses simplified micro-detail: condensed sans approximation instead of Nord's typeface, simplified screw heads/brushed texture/scale numerals, classic Hammond drawbar cap colors differing subtly from the photo.
OLED typography was corrected in pass 1 (audit:40) so the Synth patch name renders untruncated ('Super S...' vs 'Supe...').
stage1-narrow.png at 390x844 shows the complete chassis, all six sections and all 73 keys visible with no clipping.
stage1-visual-audit.md:18-21: narrow width fraction 0.97, aspect 3.0952, deck/keys 0.5399/0.46, no document scroll, per-control visibility audit passes.
stage1-capture.json: narrow capture consoleMessages [] and pageErrors [] — clean render at 390x844.
Disclosed limitation (audit:69): at 390px legends become sub-pixel/illegible and a ~1px rounding sliver can remain in the Program strip, though everything stays rendered and unclipped.
src/input/controller.ts InstrumentController routes pointer/keyboard/midi through one noteOn/noteOff with per-source held-note ownership (a note held by two sources releases only when both release).

src/input/midi.ts handles NOTE_ON (velocity 0 → note-off), NOTE_OFF, CC64 sustain, hot-plug via onstatechange, and denied/unsupported/disconnected states with cleanup (onDisconnectCleanup → allNotesOff).
src/App.tsx:100-108 registers keydown/keyup/blur with blur → controller.allNotesOff('blur'); midi.dispose on unmount (:61); controller.dispose on unmount (:113).

inputs.test.tsx and midi.test.ts cover pointer, independent multi-touch, repeat suppression, space-bar sustain, MIDI note/velocity/CC64/hot-plug/disconnect/denied/unsupported (feature-matrix piano.basic-inputs).

src/audio/engine.ts noteOn applies a velocity curve (peak = 0.04 + 0.32*vel^1.5), retrigger quick-release, deterministic oldest-seq voice stealing at MAX_POLYPHONY=24, and per-voice timer-based cleanup.
engine.setSustain latches released keys (sustained flag) and releases them on pedal-up; allNotesOff quick-releases every voice for blur/midi-disconnect/unmount.

sustain-polyphony.test.ts asserts sustain hold, no note resurrection, 24-voice cap, deterministic oldest-first stealing repeated identically, and monotonic velocity→level (peaks[2]>peaks[1]>peaks[0]).
note-lifecycle.test.ts asserts lazy start, oscillators reach the destination, releasing-voice accounting, and post-cleanup only master gain+compressor remain live.

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:6 declares 'Generated live synthesis (no recorded samples)... Piano-like by design and honestly not a sampled piano', sampleSources [] and generatedSources listing src/audio/engine.ts.
engine.ts:106 status message 'Basic piano voice ready (generated synthesis — no samples).' matches the declaration; idle/loading/ready/fallback/error states all present (EngineStatus).
engine.ts:107-118 provides a real fallback path (master gain without limiter) reporting 'fallback' status, and error status on context failure.
status-cleanup.test.ts (feature-matrix piano.basic-status-cleanup) verifies truthful idle/loading/ready/fallback/error status and cleanup through internal paths only.

decorative-controls.test.tsx exercises knob (aria-valuenow 0→127), drawbar (min 0/max 8, pointer and keyboard), fader, wheel, spring-loaded stick (returns to 0), and latching button (aria-pressed + data-lit) by both pointer and keyboard.
accessibility.test.tsx (feature-matrix accessibility.controls) asserts every control exposes accessible name, correct role, value min/max/now, toggle state, focusability, and keyboard operation.
src/state/presentation.ts setValue clamps to each control's min/max and toggle flips latching state; usePresentationValue/Toggle drive the visual state.
stage1-visual-audit.md:57-58 exercised Master Level knob (Arrow 64→68, drag→110), Mod 1 toggle, drawbar 2 pulled 0→4 in real headless Chrome.
src/state/presentation.ts PresentationStore holds only visual position/lit state with 'no connection to the audio engine, no canonical instrument state' — structurally isolated.

decorative-controls.test.tsx:91 'operating panel controls never creates audio or voices (decorative honesty)' asserts getContext() is null after panel interaction; :107-120 asserts panel controls do not silence/alter playing keybed voices (oscillator count and master gain unchanged).
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:19 'Only keybed note input and the sustain input path (space bar, MIDI CC64) reach the audio graph. Every visible panel control is decorative presentation state only.'
controller.allNotesOff comment (controller.ts:77) confirms the cleanup path is internal and not wired to the visible Panic button, which stays decorative (audit:28).

Clean module separation: src/model (variant/hardware/keys), src/state/presentation, src/input (controller/midi/keymap), src/audio (engine/boundaries), src/components — input and audio decoupled via injectable boundaries.

129 it() test cases across model, components, input, and audio; injectable AudioContext/timers/MIDI fakes (src/test/fakes.ts, src/audio/boundaries.ts) let tests run without devices, network, or audio output.

Tests are real-boundary, not state mocks: the fake AudioContext exposes oscillators(), reachesDestination(), liveNodes() and node kinds so note-lifecycle.test.ts proves signal path to destination and cleanup to baseline.
tests/feature-matrix.json maps every Phase 1 feature ID to specific test files; normalized hardware model uses stable per-section ids (src/model/hardware.ts).
stage1-capture.json: both desktop and narrow captures report consoleMessages [] and pageErrors []; audit:63 confirms zero console messages during the full interaction pass (favicon 404 fixed).
engine.dispose closes the context and returns to idle so React StrictMode mount/cleanup/mount cycles stay sound (engine.ts:293-306).
cleanupVoice clears timers and disconnects all owned nodes; note-lifecycle.test.ts asserts active/held voice counts return to 0 and only master nodes remain after release.
audit:52-59 documents real headless-Chrome exercised flows (idle→ready on C4, multi-touch C4/E4/G4, sustain, decorative knob/drawbar) with no errors.

issues: At 390x844 the whole instrument is width-scaled so legends become sub-pixel and illegible (nothing clips) — usable for inspection but not for reading labels.

Micro-detail fidelity is simplified: condensed sans instead of Nord's typeface, no screw heads/brushed texture/printed scale numerals, and drawbar cap colors follow classic Hammond convention rather than the exact photo tones.

Program section renders eight numbered buttons (following the reference/manual and Phase 3 Live slots) rather than the visual spec's 'five live-program buttons'; disclosed in the audit as a deliberate reading.
